# Sample Playback playhead (USER_REPORTS_R2 §1c, spec 05 §6: redraw every
# >= 5 ms): a held pad shows a moving play-position line (redrawn every
# frame while it moves); it disappears when the sample has stopped.
wait 300
tone-sample 1 88200
tap SAMPLEPLAYBACK
expect-screen Sample Playback
expect-playhead off
pad 0 down
wait 50
expect-playhead on
fps-reset
wait 300
expect-fps 25
expect-playhead on
screenshot ../build/sim/playhead-oneshot.png
pad 0 up
wait 2500
expect-playhead off
